notes.title: Give them bots some love...
notes.content:
1. Added a function that will auto start a match with bots if a room is open to long with no players
  -This may also change game types to a suitable game mode that bots can play.

2. Bots can now use teleporters.
  -This change also comes with some general bot upgrades and logic. 
  -This should help the bots not fall through the floor or get stuck.

3. Added outlines to help players identify friend or foe.
  -In team play mode the outline will match the teams color.
  -if no team color is available the outline will be red.
  -This should help in low light scenarios and fit the futuristic tech vibe.

notes.title: Update 03/14/2024
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs: 

- Removed a notification asking players to confirm their email address during account creations, when we do not collect email addresses.
- Found an issue with hero selection failed to appear for new accounts that try to play a game, before visiting the hero screen. Now the Hero selection cards should appear even if they do not visit the hero loadout screen.
- Found an issue, Ai-Bots where not applying damage to players with their new weapons. They were still proficient at fighting each other but suffered a serious setback when facing players. They can now use their new weapons against players as well.

notes.title: Update for 03/08/2024
notes.content:
Gave the Bots some love.

BOTS:
1. Replaced the shotgun with NG-3180 
2. Replaced old idle, run aim, walk aim, fire and reload animations.
3. Ensured that they will be firing the correct sound effects and Special effects.
4 Replaced the pistol with the P95 and replaced its animations and Special effects as well.

Hero Selection in map:
1. Added in information about Heroes loadouts.
2. Added logic to allow the Hero selection cards to follow user defined UI Colors.

Armory:
1. Preview Weapons Camos that are locked via hovering over the locked Camo.
2. Clicking the Camo will take you to the store.

notes.title: Update for 02/22/2024
notes.content:
Added Post processing volumes to the Moon Outpost Map.

Addressed numerous bugs that where being tracked. Including: 

1. Spawn points causing bots to not function properly. 
2. An issue causing a failure to create accounts.
3. An Issue that caused bots to fail their field of view checks and aggressively attack the sky.
4. Cleaned up some basic code in the main menu.
5. An issue where camo's where not being applied to weapons.
6. An issue causing no camera to be inactive when loading into a map, leaving the player unable to see.
